title: Nominalization and Verbal Alternatives
summary: Transforming between verbal and nominal styles in formal and professional German.
whyItMatters: Nominalization creates dense formal prose, while verbal alternatives often improve clarity and reveal agency.

mentalModel.title: Turn an action into a concept
mentalModel.content: Convert verbs or adjectives into nouns and adjust articles, prepositions, and participants.

mentalModel.title: Choose density deliberately
mentalModel.content: Use nominal style for labels and compact relations; use verbs when actors and actions should remain visible.

ruleBlocks.title: Build common nominal forms
ruleBlocks.content: Use suffixes such as -ung, -heit, -keit, -tion and nominalized infinitives.

ruleBlocks.title: Recode participants with genitive or prepositions
ruleBlocks.content: Transform 'Unternehmen automatisieren Aufgaben' into 'die Automatisierung von Aufgaben durch Unternehmen'.

ruleBlocks.title: Restore clear verbal clauses
ruleBlocks.content: Replace heavy function-verb or noun chains when direct verbs communicate more clearly.

tables.title: Verbal and Nominal Style
rows: die Digitalisierung von Prozessen durch Unternehmen

examples.de: Die Einführung neuer Software erfordert eine sorgfältige Schulung.
examples.en: The introduction of new software requires careful training.

examples.de: Weil das Unternehmen Prozesse automatisiert, verändern sich Aufgaben.
examples.en: Because the company automates processes, tasks change.
examples.note: A verbal alternative makes the actor explicit.

examples.de: Eine übermäßige Nominalisierung kann die Verständlichkeit verringern.

commonMistakes.wrong: Create long noun chains without clear relationships.
commonMistakes.correct: Add prepositions or use a verbal clause.
commonMistakes.reason: Readers must identify actor, action, and object.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume nominal style is always more professional.
commonMistakes.correct: Choose the form that best serves precision and readability.

comparisons.summary: Workplace reports provide authentic nominal and verbal formulations.
Moderators often verbalize dense claims when summarizing them orally.
